source.dataset_title: Ümumi təhsil müəssisələrinin regionlar üzrə tabeliyi
source.publisher: Azərbaycan Respublikasının Elm və Təhsil Nazirliyi

excluded_rows.name: Şərti məktəb
excluded_rows.reason: literal placeholder row, not a real school

notes.no_school_code: No national school code is published; the CSV has no id column. The importer must mint its own stable id. (name, rayon_raw) is unique across all emitted rows and is the only available natural key.
notes.name_is_verbatim: `name` is the source string verbatim: internal double spaces, curly quotes and Cyrillic homoglyphs are all preserved. Only `level` and `school_number` detection normalizes them internally.

level_semantics.unknown: the name carries no level marker - this is an honest gap, not a guess

notes.duplicate_names: Duplicates are emitted, never dropped. One name repeats: "Kərimbəyli kənd tam orta məktəb" in Babək and in Şərur - two different rayons, so almost certainly two real schools. Flagged; the merge decision belongs to the importer, not to this file.
notes.rayon_vocabulary: `rayon` is matched EXACTLY against the 87 divisions of the State Statistical Committee classification of 16 Feb 2024 (64 rayons + 11 republic cities + 12 Bakı intra-city rayons). No fuzzy matching: an unmatched value yields null plus a `rayon_unmatched` flag.

flags_legend.rayon_unmatched: Rayon value is not one of the 87 known divisions; rayon is null.
flags_legend.duplicate_name_in_source: This exact name appears more than once in the source file.
flags_legend.cyrillic_homoglyph_in_name: Name contains Cyrillic a/o/A/k typed in place of the Latin letter. Preserved verbatim in `name`.
flags_legend.number_range_first_taken: Name carries a number RANGE (e.g. "189-190 nömrəli"); school_number is the FIRST number, for sort order only.
flags_legend.level_ambiguous_word_order: Name contains "tam" and "orta" but not adjacently, so the level was NOT inferred. Needs human review.
